_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs' Soldat 2 egg (MIT).
name: Soldat 2
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The 2D deathmatch shooter with ragdoll physics. Installs the dedicated server, which patches itself to the newest game version when it starts.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Soldat 2. Downloads the Linux server from Transhuman Design. The server
# patches itself to the newest game version when it starts. Your settings
# (autoconfig.ini) and custom levels, rules and scripts are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

branch="${BRANCH:-release}"
url="https://dl.thd.vg/soldat2-linuxserver-$branch.tar.gz"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"

# The download has no version or checksum: its ETag says whether it changed.
etag=$(curl -fsSI --retry 3 "$url" | tr -d '\r' | awk -F': ' 'tolower($1) == "etag" { print $2 }') ||
    fail "dl.thd.vg can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
if [ -x soldat2 ] && [ -n "$etag" ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-soldat2 2>/dev/null)" = "$branch $etag" ]; then
    echo "The latest Soldat 2 $branch server is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading the Soldat 2 $branch server"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/server.tar.gz" "$url" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    mkdir "$build/x"
    # Without the debug symbols, which only matter to the developers.
    tar -xzf "$build/server.tar.gz" -C "$build/x" --strip-components=1 --exclude='*_s.debug'
    [ -f "$build/x/soldat2" ] || fail "The download didn't contain the server. Reinstall to try again."
    cp -a "$build/x/." /mnt/server/
    chmod +x soldat2
    echo "$branch $etag" > .raptor-soldat2
fi

# The server rewrites a settings file it doesn't recognise as complete, so
# this is its own default, with the settings the server's Startup page owns.
if [ ! -f autoconfig.ini ]; then
    cat > autoconfig.ini <<'INI'
[DesignerFile]
LastFilename = new_level

[PatreonIntegration]
Token = 

[AntiLag]
AntiLagAdjustment = 0.00

[GameServerConfig]
Name = A Soldat 2 server
Address = 0.0.0.0
Port = 23073
WebSocketsPort = 0
WebSocketsRconPort = 0
CertificateName = 
CertificatePassword = 
CertificateProtocols = 4092
RconPassword = 
UseIPv6 = False
DefaultKickSecs = 3600.00
MaxPlayers = 12
VisibleInGamesList = True
GreetMessage = Welcome! Be friendly, help newcomers and have fun!
AdminPlayfabId = 
SecurityChecks = True
TimeOutPlayersSecs = 90.00
AutoShutdownAfterHours = 12
AutoShutdownAfterMatches = 50
ServerPassword = 
AllowTeamChanging = True
EndMatchIfPlayersLeft = True
UseBuiltInPatching = True
RestartAfterPatching = True
UpdateURL = https://update.thd.vg
PatchURL = https://dl.thd.vg

[GamesCycle]
GamesCycleFile = Cycles/Standard/cycle-default.json
ShuffleGamesCycle = True

[BalanceTeams]
AutoBalance = True

[Lobby]
UseLobby = True
MinimumPlayersToStart = 2
PercentOfPlayersToReady = 1.00
HalfReadySecs = 30.00

[Voting]
AllowVoting = True
AutoVoteOnMatchEnd = True
LevelsToVote = 3
VotingPercentRequired = 35
VoteMapIntervalSecs = 30

[ConfigUpdater]
Version = 36
INI
fi
echo "Installed the Soldat 2 $branch server."

variables.name: Branch
variables.description: release, or test for the developers' test builds. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once, up to 12.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty lets anyone join.

variables.name: Greeting
variables.description: The message players see when they join.
variables.default_value: Welcome! Be friendly and have fun!

variables.name: Admin PlayFab ID
variables.description: Your PlayFab ID, which makes you an admin: the console shows it when you join.

variables.name: WebSockets port
variables.description: A port for players joining from a browser, one of the server's ports. 0 turns it off.

variables.name: Remote console port
variables.description: A port for the WebSocket remote console, one of the server's ports. 0 turns it off.

variables.name: Remote console password
variables.description: The password the remote console asks for first.
